name: setup-manaflow-ai-duotone-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces. The window has exactly two tones of one gray, a fixed lightness step apart (0.03 in OKLCH, light and dark): the chrome (sidebar, tab strip, toolbar) and the work (the pane you are in). No hue separates anything and the selected row is neutral; lines only separate neighbours of the same tone. Every size is a fraction of one row height (28): a 16 icon, 13 type, a 6 inset, an 8 corner, a 40 strip, a 252 sidebar, a 756 reading column. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
